services: On-call professional engineering and consulting services, including civil and structural design, surveying, geotechnical services, permitting, right-of-way support, PS&E preparation, construction management, construction engineering, contract administration, planning and regulatory updates, and grant support.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call services without a defined technical structure.
- Broad municipal civil engineering scope, mostly roads, utilities, planning, and administration.
- Includes some structural design, but no specific bridge, roof, building, or special structure project is identified.
- Explicitly not attractive for sbp due to framework/on-call character without technical specification.
- Significant portions concern planning, permitting, geotechnics, and comprehensive plan updates rather than structural engineering.
